sloka: एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थं समुद्रस्य वरानने ।यत्र सागरमुत्तीर्य तां रात्रिमुषिता वयम् ।। ६.१२६.११ ।।
transliteration: etattu dṛśyate tīrthaṁ samudrasya varānane ।yatra sāgaramuttīrya tāṁ rātrimuṣitā vayam ।। 6.126.11 ।।

translations.english: "Yuddhonmatta and Matta both Rakshasa chiefs, and also Nikumbha and Kumbha, sons of Kumbhakarna (killed by Hanuman and Sugriva), and Vajradamshtra and Damshtra (killed by Angada), and Maha raksha who was difficult to encounter was killed by me in the combat."
translations.hindi: बहुत दिनों बाद श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के दशेन पाने से ) सीता जी के नेत्र हिरनो की तरह प्रफल्लित हो गए थे, किन्तु श्रीराम चन्द्र द जी के इन वचनों को सुन, उन नेत्रो में आँसु भर आए
